notes: Chunk 106: 23 candidates, 4 program-list (Utah Eccles job market candidates and 2011-2021 job placements; Wisconsin School of Business job candidates and 2015-2021 selected placements), 0 single-record, 19 not-a-list. Institutions kept as given for every page. Integrator notes: (1) the Utah and Wisconsin pages cover all business-school areas; the Operations sections are small (Utah Operations: Scott Lindsey 2012, Francois Giraud-Carrier 2014, Ming Jin and Chunlin Wang 2016, Sina Moghadas Khorasani 2019; Wisconsin OIM: Keehyung Kim 2016, Jungwon Kuem 2018, Mohamad Soltani 2020) and the Utah list mixes post-doc and visiting placements with tenure-track ones, while Wisconsin's list is explicitly 'representative' tenure-track placements only. (2) The two job-market-candidate pages name candidates without placements; they are 2021 snapshots. (3) The Ivey placement page is a shell; its two pagesBelow (job market candidates and alumni) are the likely list pages and were not in this batch. (4) Two UVA computer-engineering pages (CRISP theses; Computer Engineering PhD graduates with first jobs) and the Strathclyde EEE supervised-theses page do list named doctoral graduates but belong to departments outside operations or management and were marked not-a-list per the brief.
